title: Aguas para Beber e para Sorvetes (Drinking Waters and for Sorbets)
description: Prepared with fruit or cherries or strawberries or blackberries or currants, water, and sugar.

ingredients.name: ripe fruit (such as cherries, strawberries, blackberries, currants, or other)

steps: In each three quarts of water, pour one pound of ripe fruit such as cherries, strawberries, blackberries, currants, or any other.
Crush with a spoon and mix very well in the water.
Strain through a cloth and sweeten with sugar.
Strain again through a cloth filter.
Put in a cool place and serve this water when occasion arises.
If it is for sorbets, add more sugar, put it in an ice cream maker of Flanders sheets, surround it with snow and salt, and as it begins to freeze, scrape off what sticks to the sides with a spoon.
Cover the ice cream maker with its lid and stir constantly with it until it is equally frozen, then fill cups with it at the moment you wish to drink it, and serve it without delay.

ingredients.name: A piece of beef weighing fifteen or twenty pounds

Tie it with twine and place it in a pot with a bottom lined with bacon slices and beef slices, seasoned with salt, pepper, cloves, onions, carrots, two heads of garlic, and a bundle of fine herbs
Cover with beef and bacon slices as below

Place to cook in a pot with one canada of red wine and two of water, with some cloves studded onions, one head of garlic, carrots, parsnips, bay leaf, marjoram, thyme, and nutmeg

half of it combined with fat meat, well cleaned of skins

title: Biscuits de Farinha de arroz (Rice Flour Biscuits)
description: A biscuit made with rice flour, egg yolks, and lime.

ingredients.name: Four ounces of rice flour, sifted through fine silk sieve
A little finely chopped lime peel
Fifteen or sixteen egg whites, beaten and well raised

steps: Sift through a very fine silk sieve four ounces of rice flour, put it in a bowl with one arratél of fine sugar, eight egg yolks, a little finely chopped lime peel
Beat everything with two spoons for the time of a quarter hour
Carefully mix fifteen or sixteen well-beaten and raised egg whites
Form afterwards some paper boxes greased with butter inside, put the composition in them
Put them to bake in a very mild oven
When cooked, remove them from the boxes, cover them with white glaze made with one egg white, fine sugar and some drops of lemon juice
Put them in the oven again and when the glaze is dry, remove them and serve them when it is necessary

title: Biscuits de vários doces (Biscuits of Various Sweets)
description: A biscuit made with citron or lemon peel, orange, and marmalade or apricots.

ingredients.name: Two or three ounces of citron or lemon peel
A little orange flower in powder, covered
Two small spoonfuls of marmalade, of apricots or any other

steps: Grind in a stone mortar two or three ounces of citron or lemon peel, add a little orange flower powder covered, two small spoonfuls of marmalade of apricots or any other, four ounces of fine sugar, four or five egg yolks
After everything is ground and well mixed, pass through a sieve with force until everything dries
Add afterwards the well-beaten egg whites, mix everything well
Form the biscuits with a spoon on sheets of paper, like the preceding ones
Pulverize with fine sugar on top, bake in a mild oven and serve them like the preceding ones

title: Bolinhos de amêndoa (Almond Balls or Marzipans)
description: Prepared with almonds, egg whites, and marmalade or apricot.

ingredients.name: A little marmalade or apricot preserve or any other
A little orange flower covered and reduced to powder
More fine sugar for preventing sticking

steps: Blanched, cleaned and dried one arratél of almonds, grind them in a stone mortar, adding from time to time up to three egg whites
When ground, add a little marmalade or apricot preserve or any other, a little orange flower covered and reduced to powder
Mix everything and dry it with fine sugar on the fire
Once dried, pour it on a table with another little sugar until the paste stops sticking to the hands
Cut afterwards into pieces, make them into little rolls, form the marzipans in the shape desired
Pass them through half-beaten egg whites, place them on fine sugar and pulverize them on all sides with the same sugar
When well covered with it, place them on sheets of white paper and these on sheets of copper
Put them to bake in a mild oven and serve them when necessary

title: Bolo de Bacia (Basin Cake)
description: A cake made with egg yolks, rose water, and almonds.

ingredients.name: one arratel of sugar in point

half a dozen cooked egg yolks

steps: Knead half a quarter of flour with cold water seasoned with salt
Add two egg yolks, little butter, and rose water
When very well kneaded, cut it into strands
Spread into thin leaves the size of the basin
In a basin well greased with butter, put in a leaf

Cover with another leaf
Over it put a dozen strands of white blancmange beaten with six egg yolks and a quarter of sugar

Over it put some soft eggs with cinnamon on top

Send to the oven
When cooked, if desired, cut into slices of desired size

title: Cabeça de Vitella ao Natural (Veal Head in its Natural State)
description: Prepared with veal, bay leaf, and onion.

ingredients.name: one veal head, skinned and blanched
some slices of lemon without peel

steps: After the head is skinned and well blanched, and singed over a well-lit hearth, remove the jaws and the bone of the nose up to the eyes, lifting the skin very carefully without damaging it
Soak it in water for a whole night
Blanch it in fresh water
After giving it a few boilings, remove it and put it in cold water
Scrape the inside of the jaws very well, wash them very well, tie it with twine

Put it to cook in a white broth made with a little flour dissolved in a pan of water, seasoned with salt, whole pepper, one bundle of herbs, bay leaf, marjoram, onion studded with cloves, pieces of parsnip, carrots, some slices of lemon without peel, and one glass of white wine
When cooked, remove it and let it drain

After removing the bones and uncovering the brains, place it in a good shape on the serving plate with its spicy sauce on top made with a little broth, vinegar, salt, pepper, and finely chopped fines herbes
It can also be served with different sauces, such as ravigota, peverada, or Italian style
Note that it can also be made without fines herbes or roots, in case they are not available

title: Cabeça de Vitella Recheada (Stuffed Veal Head)
description: Prepared with veal, veal brains, and beef fat.
steps: Take a well-blanched and singed veal head, place it on a table with cloth underneath
Open it between the jaws, remove all the bones without damaging the skin of the upper part

Fill the head with this mixture, giving it its same shape, tying it very well with twine on all sides so the forcemeat does not escape
Put it to cook in a pan with broth, one quart of white wine, some roots, one bundle with fines herbes, onion studded with cloves, salt, and whole pepper
When cooked, remove it and let it drain
When dry, remove the twine and serve with spicy sauce as above

title: Calda ou Xarope de Flor de Violas (Violet Flower Syrup)
description: Prepared with violet flowers, water, and sugar.
steps: Place four ounces of violet flowers in a bowl.
Pour a quart of boiling water over them.
Cover the bowl with its lid.
Let it infuse for two hours over gentle heat.
Strain through a cloth and squeeze well.

If it produces half a pint, pour it into two and a half pounds of sugar in the hard crack stage, which is known by dipping two fingers in cold water, then in the sugar, and dipping again in cold water—if the sugar sticks to the fingers and breaks between them.
Add the half pint of violet water, and incorporate it into the sugar without boiling.
Pour into a bowl.
Cover it.
Place it over gentle heat for three days.
At the end of this time, dip your fingers in it, wet them in the syrup, then open them and if they form a thread that does not break, pour it into bottles and keep for when needed.

title: Calda ou Xarope de Marmelos (Quince Syrup)
description: Prepared with quinces and sugar.
steps: Peel and clean a dozen ripe quinces inside.
Chop and pound them very well.
Put them in a cloth and squeeze all the juice forcefully into a bowl.
Let it settle, then take the clearest part.
For each quart of juice, have one pound of sugar in the hair stage.
Adding this juice to the sugar, let it boil until it takes on the consistency of a syrup.

title: Caldo em Vestidinhos com Conserva (Portable Meat Broth with Preserves)
description: A soup made with leg of beef, veal, and mutton.

ingredients.name: two legs of veal by weight

steps: Clean and empty all the birds, remove feathers, soak them well along with the meat from the legs of beef and veal made in large pieces free of fat and bones
Wash and scald everything very well
Put in a large pot or kettle full of water and bring to boil slowly
Season with salt
Add two dozen cloves of the Indies, two or three ounces of whole pepper and ginger, all tied in a cloth

After two hours of boiling, add a decoction of seven or eight measures of shredded venison, a bundle of carrots, bundles of parsnips, turnips, leeks, celery, and whole onions, all blanched in boiling water and tied with twine
When all is cooked, pass the broth through a cloth with pressure
When almost cold and without fat, pour into a basin and place over a furnace

Pass again through a cloth
When clear, transfer to a large pot and bring to boil slowly again, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon until the broth is reduced

Let cool, then cut into equal pieces each weighing about an ounce
Place on trays or in sieves with paper leaves underneath and set to dry in a stove or expose to north wind for several days
When completely dry, wrap each piece in paper and store in wide-mouthed jars very well sealed
To use, dissolve one or one and a half ounces in a quarter measure of boiling water depending on desired strength
In case of illness, give the sick one broth of these every four hours

title: Cuscús (Couscous)
description: Prepared with flour and water.

ingredients.name: One quarter of ground grain flour

steps: Take one quarter of ground grain flour sifted through a fine sieve.
Put it in a mortar and sprinkle it with a limited amount of water, twisting it in your hands with great force in only one direction so that it becomes granular.

When all the flour is made this way, pour it into a winnowing basket and winnow it, what stays on top is the couscous and what falls below is ground again with the same fine sprinkler or with a sprig of myrtle or other clean thing that is not bitter.
The water used to sprinkle the flour should have a bit of wheat grain in it.
Once the flour is finished this way, place the couscous in a couscous maker lined very well with paper inside.
Place a pot of iron or clay on a trivet with water over the heat and when it boils well place the couscous maker over the mouth of the pot.

When the couscous is cooked, which will taste like cooked bread, remove it and return it to the mortar to break it up again with great force in only one direction and when broken up, place it in the sun to dry and harden.
This is how couscous is made.

description: Prepared with chickens, bay leaf, and sweet almonds.

ingredients.name: half a canada of good cow's milk

Take half a canada of good cow's milk and bring to boil with a bay leaf, marjoram, and a little pounded coriander

Add the breasts of two roasted chickens, one arratel of pork fat cut very fine, and eight egg yolks
Season with salt, pepper, spices, and nutmeg
Incorporate over low heat
When thickened and cooled, stuff the chickens and sew with needle so the filling does not escape
Blanch in boiling water, then cook in a casserole with hot milk, salt, and dried coriander
Cover with slices of pork fat and sheets of paper, letting them simmer gently

description: Prepared with fat, bacon, and ham.

When cooked, let cool, then cover with a thickened sauce made with a piece of butter dusted with flour, two egg yolks, and a drop of milk.

Arrange the breast fillets with their marinade on top
Cover with bacon slices and cook between two fires for a little while

title: Frangas à Montmorency (Chickens Montmorency)
description: Prepared with chickens, bacon, and pork.
steps: Flambe and singe two or three chickens, open them by the sides, empty them, and remove the breast bones without damaging the meat.

After filling, sew with needle and thread, and place to cook with bacon slices, veal slices, and ham slices, onion studded with cloves, one bundle of parsley, fine herbs, and moisten with one spoonful of good broth.
After cooking, pass the broth through a sieve, remove the fat, and reduce until it becomes like a fricandeau, and brown the chickens in it with the bacon underneath.

title: Frangãos à Franceza (Chickens French Style)
description: Prepared with chickens, mutton, and bread.
steps: After cleaning four chickens well with their beaks and feet, place them in a pot; when half-cooked, remove them
Stuff with two arratels of chopped mutton seasoned as for pastries and a bread loaf; open the chickens along the back
Place the stuffed bread in the middle of a buttered plate and arrange the chickens around it, with four portions of chicory, lettuce, or cardoon between them
When the plate is ready, place six egg yolks beaten with lemon and one spoonful of broth from the pot on top
Brown the plate and send to the table

title: Fricassé de Pombos feito com Sangue (Pigeon Fricassée Made with Blood)
description: Prepared with pigeon, pigeons, and bacon.
steps: Take five or six young pigeons and save their blood, stirring it as it cools so it does not coagulate
Prepare the pigeons the same way as those in compote

After passing them through the fire in a casserole with melted bacon, salt, pepper, a slice of ham, a sprig of parsley, and an onion studded with cloves, moisten them with stock and thicken with a little veal coulis
When cooked, skim off the fat, pass the blood through a sieve, and add it to the fricassée, taking care that it does not boil
When bound and of good taste, arrange on a plate and serve hot as an entrance course

title: Fruta de Ciringa (Choux Pastry Fritters)
description: A pastry dish made with oil or melted butter, milk, and butter.

ingredients.name: oil or melted butter for frying

steps: Put half a canada of milk in a pot to boil
When it boils, add a quarter of butter, a quarter of sugar, and an eighth of flour
Cook this mixture, stirring until it becomes very hard
Remove the pot from the fire and add a dozen eggs, two by two, beating the mixture very well until it becomes soft
Fry in boiling oil or butter using a piping bag greased with butter or oil
When fried, pass through sugar in thread stage with cinnamon on top and serve at the table

title: Fruta de Manjar Branco (Almond Blancmange Fruit Pastry)
description: A pastry dish made with almond, egg yolks, and powdered sugar.
steps: Put in a pan six tiguelas of almond blancmange with twelve egg yolks and one arratel of powdered sugar
Bring to a boil to thicken and let cool
Knead one eighth of flour with half arratel of butter, four egg yolks, and one quarter of sugar
When kneaded, make two cakes and stretch on a board until very thin
Place the beaten blancmange on one cake, spread it, and cover with the other cake
Cut with a wheel cutter in the shape of fartes
Fry in butter and pass through sugar
Send to the table

title: Fígados de Vitela em Crespílsa (Veal Livers in Caul)
description: Prepared with veal, beef fat, and bone marrow.

ingredients.name: Bone marrow from bread cooked in milk

steps: The veal livers, with an equal amount of beef fat, are pounded in a mortar, adding to it a bone marrow of bread cooked in milk, two large onions cut into cubes, and passed through butter, fine herbs, cucumbers, salt, pepper, egg yolks; pounded, add beaten egg whites to it; line a pot with slices of lard, and place on it a pork caul, or well washed and well dried caul, pour over it the pounded liver, cover it with the same caul well folded and moistened with beaten eggs, so that it remains stuck; cover it with paper, and place it to cook on a gentle fire above and below; when cooked, turn it over on a plate, and after drying and in fat, serve it with sauce of clear ham essence, and verjuice or lemon juice

title: Galeirões assados e recheados (Roasted and Stuffed Gannets)
description: Prepared with bread crumbs, red wine, and garlic.
steps: Singe, clean, and remove the entrails from the gannets
Prepare a stuffing of bread crumbs, fresh butter, flour, two spoonfuls of red wine, parsley, chopped garlic, seasoned with salt, pepper, cloves, grated nutmeg, bay leaf, and powdered thyme
Mix all together and stuff inside the gannets
Sew the opening with thread, place on the spit and roast, basting with white wine, salt, and melted butter
Once roasted, serve with its own sauce, sprinkled with grated bread crust and lemon juice

title: Galeirões de vários modos para entrada (Gannets in Various Ways for Entrée)
description: Prepared with eel, fish roe, and garlic.
steps: After cleaning the gannets, blanch and lard them with eel fillets and fish roe
Prepare a stuffing of gannet livers, butter, fine herbs, parsley, half a garlic clove, seasoned with salt, pepper, grated nutmeg, small pieces of chopped sour orange peel, bound with two egg yolks
Stuff the gannets and sew the opening with thread, tie with string
Place in a pan with fish stock, a glass of red wine, seasoned with salt and pepper, parsley, fine herbs, sprigs of pennyroyal, an onion studded with cloves, and two garlic cloves
Allow to simmer little by little for four or five hours
Once cooked, remove from the pan, prepare a ragout of turnips cooked in the same broth, and after binding and removing the fat, add pieces of fried bread crumbs
Serve with sour orange or lemon juice
They may also be served with ragouts and different garnishes such as oysters, mussels, and others

title: Galete para Dias de Carne (Roasted Poultry for Meat Days)
description: Prepared with liver, lard, and onions.

ingredients.name: One spoonful of ham coulis (culi de presunto)

steps: Remove the innards from the cleaned poultry, keeping the legs inside the body

Stuff with a finely chopped mixture made from the poultry's livers, scraped lard, parsley, small onions, and truffles, all finely minced and seasoned with salt and pepper, bound together with three or four egg yolks
Close the opening with thread
Place in a braise with slices of lard and slices of veal or beef, seasoned and of good flavor
Cook between two fires
Add one spoonful of broth and one spoonful of white wine
Let simmer for four or five hours
When cooked, add one spoonful of ham coulis and one splash of vinegar to the bottom of the braise
Strain this sauce through a sieve
Serve hot as an entrée

title: Galeto ou Bolo de Boeuf (Beef or Other Meat Terrine)
description: Prepared with meat, beef, and leg of mutton.

ingredients.name: meat fillets and sinews from the loins and thighs of wild boar
a quarter liter of white wine

steps: Take the meat fillets and sinews from the loins and thighs of wild boar, a loin of beef, and a leg of mutton, and add a forcemeat of ham
Chop everything together on a board with parsley, small onions, and a clove of garlic, seasoned with salt, pepper, some spices, and fine herbs
Place it in a terrine with three or four handfuls of bacon cut into dice, six egg yolks, and a quarter liter of white wine
Mix and blend together very well
Line a casserole with bacon slices and arrange the forcemeat inside so that it is well packed and united
Cover with other bacon slices, paper leaves, and its lid, and place in a hot oven for four or five hours
Allow it to cool in the same casserole; once cooked and cold, unmold it and serve on a napkin

title: Galinha Armado (Armed Chicken)
description: Prepared with chicken, lamb, and bacon.
steps: Mince one chicken with two arratels of lamb, half arratel of bacon, and all aromatics, being careful to leave the eggs from the chicken whole.
When half of all this meat is stewed, return it to the chopping block to be minced together with the other half and season with all seasonings, vinegar, four eggs, and one quarter of bread crumbs.

title: Galinha Armado (Stuffed Chicken)
description: Prepared with chicken, mutton, and pork.
steps: Chop one chicken with two arratels of mutton, half arratel of pork, and all aromatics, leaving the chicken eggs whole
Once half of all this meat is braised, return it to the chopping block to be chopped together with the other half
Season with all seasonings, vinegar, four eggs, and one quarter of grated bread
After the meat is seasoned, arm the chicken with the bones in a buttered frying pan
When it reaches the desired size, arrange strips of pork lard on top
Place it to cook on low heat from below and on top
When cooked, place a cream broth made in the form of a gilt-head bream, and send it to the table

title: Galinha Assada (Roasted Chicken)
description: Prepared with chicken, bacon, and butter.

ingredients.name: One strip of bacon, about a palm's length and four fingers' width

steps: After one chicken is plucked, cleaned, and spitted, take one strip of bacon about a palm's length and four fingers' width, cut it into strips, and place it on the chicken on top and underneath.
Wrap the chicken in four or five sheets of paper well buttered and tie it very well with twine in many turns so that it does not come undone.
Put the chicken to roast, first moistening the paper on top with water so that it does not burn.
After the chicken is roasted, place it on the plate with the same strips of bacon, slices of bread underneath, and send it to the table.
In this manner one roasts capon, turkey, guinea fowl, and young chickens.

title: Galinha com Cidrão (Chicken with Citron)
description: Prepared with chicken, citron, and pork.
steps: Cook one chicken with one quarter of pork and aromatics
Once cooked, season with all seasonings
Make bread in slices, and cut them in the manner of dice, place them in a plate where you will pour all the chicken broth so that they become white
Add sugar and lemon to make this broth sour and sweet, and it must be browned with heat from below and on top
Then place the chicken on top, cut in quarters and passed through beaten eggs with good lemon
Cut half arratel of citron into thin small pieces, and after passed through the same eggs, place them around the plate between the chicken, thus it goes to the table

title: Galinha de Alfitete (Chicken with Batter)
description: Prepared with chicken, bacon, and wine.
steps: Cook the chicken with one arratel of bacon and aromatics with all seasonings and little water so that it remains well-bodied.
When cooked, melt the bacon and pour it into a shallow bowl in which you place the chicken in quarters to brown on low flame underneath and on top.
When browned, make a fine batter of one eighth flour with half an arratel of sugar, six eggs, its butter, and a splash of wine.
From this batter make some small balls with bay leaves, frying them and placing them in layers with sugar and cinnamon on top in a plate until full.
Place the chicken on top.
If desired, you can put egg threads on this plate.
In the same way one makes mutton, pigeons, young chickens, and kid goat.

title: Galinha de Fernão de Sousa (Fernão de Sousa's Chicken)
description: Prepared with chicken, mutton, and pork.
steps: Put one chicken in a pan with one arratel of mutton, one arratel of pork, three onions, one bunch of aromatics, vinegar, and little water
Place to cook, and when more than half cooked, remove it
Chop the chicken in one part, the mutton in another, and the pork with the aromatics in another
Also chop one dozen egg yolks
Once this is done, place some slices in a buttered frying pan or plate
After moistening them with the substance left from the chicken, spread layers upon them
Place a layer of chicken with chopped egg yolk on top, over this meat place another of mutton with chopped egg yolk on top, and over this another of pork and aromatics with chopped egg yolks
Continue the layers in this order until all is finished, shaping it like the form of a hat crown
Place six raw egg yolks on top, and between yolk and yolk some beef marrow
Cook on low heat from below and on top, and send it thus in the same frying pan or plate to the table

title: Galinha em Potagem à Francesa (Chicken in French Pottage)
description: Prepared with chicken, liver, and pork.
steps: Roast one chicken and its liver
After the liver is chopped, put it in a small mustard already prepared
Once half arratel of pork is melted and cleaned of cracklings, fry two chopped onions in it
In the same pan add the mustard mixed with the liver so that everything together becomes fried again
Season with pepper, clove, nutmeg, cardamom, so that it becomes well spicy
If you wish to add aromatics, do not add mustard
Once this pottage is made, place the roasted chicken in pieces on the plate with this pottage and lemon juice on top

title: Galinha em Pé (Chicken Standing)
description: Prepared with chicken, pork, and vinegar.
steps: Place one chicken to cook with half arratel of pork, two ounces of butter, vinegar, aromatics, all seasonings, and one quartilho of water
When the water is spent and the substance remains, carve the chicken
Without chopping the giblets, chop more meats on the block with pork and aromatics
Once very well chopped, put it in a bowl and season again with all ground seasonings, the crumb of ten réis of grated bread, and the chicken giblet separated into thick strips, and twelve egg yolks
Once everything is beaten so that it becomes well fine, put it in a frying pan with melting butter by spoonfuls, frying each spoonful on itself, and placing it on a plate upon sliced larded bread
After the breast is full, place lemon juice on top and send it to the table

steps: Cut one chicken into pieces and put them to stew with one quarter of bacon, aromatics, salt, and vinegar.
Season with all seasonings and thicken at the end with four eggs (or if you do not wish eggs, make it a parsley potage).
Place on slices of bread, lemon juice on top, and send it to the table.

description: Prepared with chicken, bacon, and white wine.

ingredients.name: One arratel of bacon, cut into dice

steps: Fry one arratel of bacon cut into dice and pour the clean fat from the cracklings into a bowl with the fat from a half-roasted chicken, a splash of white wine, little vinegar, and enough water.
Put it to stew, season with all seasonings with two bay leaves, and thicken with two egg yolks.
Place slices of bread underneath and lemon on top.
In this manner one makes turkeys, pigeons, kid goats, and loins.

title: Galinha Recheada (Stuffed Chicken)
description: Prepared with mutton, pork, and vinegar.

ingredients.name: one and a half arratels of mutton

steps: Chop in one part one and a half arratels of mutton, and in another part one quarter of pork with aromatics, all very well chopped
Place the pork and aromatics to braise with half of the mutton, and when half braised beat it on the block mixing it with the other half of the mutton
Chop everything together with three eggs, all seasonings, vinegar, and grated bread
Once this is done, stuff the chicken, and place it to roast in a frying pan, or to cook if you wish
Place it upon gilded broth with lemon juice on top, and send it to the table
